name: Food & Beverage
definition: Companies whose principal business is branded food, beverages, food processing or food distribution.
included_activities: Food manufacturers; non-alcoholic beverages; meat/dairy; food distributors.
excluded_activities: Agricultural input companies; restaurants; grocery retailers.

name: Homebuilders
definition: Companies whose principal business is residential home construction.
included_activities: Public homebuilders.
excluded_activities: Building-material suppliers and home-improvement retailers.

name: Leisure & Entertainment
definition: Companies whose principal business is live entertainment, theme/media entertainment, cruises, hotels/resorts or consumer leisure experiences.
included_activities: Live events; entertainment venues; cruises; hotels/resorts; leisure experiences.
excluded_activities: Pure online platforms; gambling-only companies; video-game publishers.

name: Retail
definition: Companies whose principal business is physical or omnichannel retailing of consumer goods.
included_activities: Mass merchants; specialty retail; discount/off-price; home improvement; auto-parts retail.
excluded_activities: Online-only marketplaces assigned to Internet Platforms; restaurants.

name: Clean Energy & Grid Transition
definition: Companies materially involved in renewable generation, clean-energy equipment, storage or grid infrastructure enabling the energy transition.
included_activities: Renewable generation; solar/wind equipment; storage; grid-transition equipment.
excluded_activities: Nuclear-only companies; conventional fossil producers; generic utilities without material clean-energy exposure.

name: Midstream & LNG Infrastructure
definition: Companies whose principal business transports, stores, processes or liquefies natural gas and hydrocarbons.
included_activities: Pipelines; gathering/processing; terminals; LNG infrastructure.
excluded_activities: Upstream producers; regulated gas utilities.

name: Natural Gas Producers
definition: Upstream producers whose production mix or commercial positioning is materially concentrated in natural gas.
included_activities: Natural-gas-focused E&P.
excluded_activities: Pipelines/LNG infrastructure; diversified integrated oil majors.

name: Nuclear Energy
definition: Companies materially involved in nuclear generation, reactor technology, nuclear components/services or uranium supply.
included_activities: Nuclear utilities/operators; reactor developers; nuclear components/services; uranium supply.
excluded_activities: General utilities with immaterial nuclear exposure.

name: Oil & Gas Producers
definition: Companies whose principal business is exploration, production or integrated production of crude oil and natural gas.
included_activities: Integrated oil majors; upstream exploration and production.
excluded_activities: Midstream pipelines; oilfield services; refiners.

name: Oil Services & Drilling
definition: Companies whose principal business supplies equipment, drilling or services to oil and gas producers.
included_activities: Oilfield services/equipment; offshore/onshore drilling; production services.
excluded_activities: Oil/gas producers; pipelines.

name: Solar
definition: Companies whose principal or material business directly develops, manufactures, installs or operates solar energy systems.
included_activities: Solar modules; inverters; utility-scale solar development/EPC; solar generation.
excluded_activities: General clean-energy utilities with only incidental solar exposure.

name: Water Infrastructure & Utilities
definition: Companies whose principal or material business supplies, treats, measures or distributes water and wastewater.
included_activities: Water utilities; pumps/treatment; water infrastructure/equipment; metering.
excluded_activities: General industrials with immaterial water exposure.

name: Capital Markets
definition: Companies whose principal business is brokerage, investment banking, exchanges, asset management, market infrastructure or financial-market data.
included_activities: Broker-dealers; exchanges; asset managers; alternative managers; ratings/index/data tied to markets.
excluded_activities: Commercial banks where capital markets is not principal.

name: Fintech & Digital Payments
definition: Companies whose principal business is digital payments, payment networks/processors, digital banking, BNPL, fintech lending or fintech infrastructure.
included_activities: Card networks; processors; digital wallets; digital banks; BNPL; fintech lending; cross-border payments.
excluded_activities: Traditional banks/brokers unless fintech platform is principal.

name: Insurance
definition: Companies whose principal business is underwriting insurance, reinsurance or insurance brokerage/services.
included_activities: P&C; life/health; specialty; reinsurance; insurance brokers.
excluded_activities: Banks and asset managers.

name: Mortgage REITs
definition: REITs and finance companies whose principal business is investing in or financing residential/commercial mortgages and mortgage-backed assets.
included_activities: Agency/non-agency mortgage REITs; commercial mortgage REITs.
excluded_activities: Equity property REITs; mortgage originators without REIT investment exposure.

name: Regional Banks
definition: Commercial banks whose business is primarily regional/community banking rather than global money-center banking.
included_activities: Regional/community banks.
excluded_activities: Fintech lenders; payment companies; money-center banks.

name: Residential REITs
definition: Equity REITs whose principal property exposure is apartments, single-family rental or manufactured-housing communities.
included_activities: Apartment REITs; single-family rental REITs; manufactured-housing communities.
excluded_activities: Healthcare, self-storage, office, industrial or diversified REITs.

name: Biotechnology
definition: Companies primarily engaged in biotechnology-based therapeutics, biologics, cell/gene therapies or biotech drug discovery.
included_activities: Biologic therapeutics; gene/cell therapy; biotech R&D.
excluded_activities: CROs, diagnostics-only firms, medical devices and diversified pharma where biotech is not the principal business.

name: Genomics & Precision Medicine
definition: Companies materially focused on genomic sequencing, gene editing, molecular diagnostics or precision-medicine platforms.
included_activities: Sequencing; gene editing; genomic diagnostics; precision medicine/data.
excluded_activities: Broad pharma/biotech with no material genomics platform.

name: Healthcare Providers & Services
definition: Companies whose principal business is delivering, financing, administering or supporting healthcare services.
included_activities: Managed care; hospitals; clinical/lab services; home/post-acute care; healthcare service platforms.
excluded_activities: Drug/device manufacturers; healthcare REITs.

name: Medical Devices & Diagnostics
definition: Companies whose principal products are medical devices, diagnostics, life-science instruments or clinical testing technologies.
included_activities: Surgical/implant devices; diagnostics; monitoring; life-science instruments.
excluded_activities: Drug developers; healthcare providers; distributors without proprietary device/diagnostic exposure.

name: Pharmaceuticals
definition: Companies whose principal business is development and commercialization of prescription pharmaceuticals.
included_activities: Large and specialty pharmaceutical developers/marketers.
excluded_activities: Medical devices, diagnostics, CROs, providers.

name: Aerospace & Defense
definition: Companies whose principal business supplies aircraft, aerospace systems, defense platforms, military electronics or defense services.
included_activities: Defense primes; aerospace OEMs; defense electronics; aircraft systems/components.
excluded_activities: General industrial companies with incidental aerospace sales.

name: Airlines
definition: Passenger airlines whose principal business is scheduled air transportation.
included_activities: Scheduled passenger airlines.
excluded_activities: Aircraft makers; airports; travel platforms; cargo-only logistics.

name: Construction & Infrastructure
definition: Companies whose principal business builds, supplies or equips large physical infrastructure and construction projects.
included_activities: Engineering/construction; heavy construction; aggregates/materials; rental/heavy equipment; grid/civil contractors.
excluded_activities: Pure homebuilders; generic industrial conglomerates.

name: Electric & Autonomous Vehicles
definition: Companies materially exposed to electric vehicles, autonomous-driving systems, vehicle autonomy sensors/computing or EV-focused vehicle production.
included_activities: EV manufacturers; autonomous-driving platforms; lidar/sensing; dedicated autonomy components.
excluded_activities: Conventional autos/components without material EV/autonomy exposure; generic semiconductors.

name: Marine Shipping
definition: Companies whose principal business is marine freight shipping, tankers, bulk carriers or maritime transport services.
included_activities: Container shipping; tankers; dry bulk; marine transport.
excluded_activities: Cruise lines; offshore oil services unless shipping is principal.

name: Space Economy
definition: Companies whose principal or material business directly provides launch, spacecraft, satellites, satellite communications, earth observation or space infrastructure.
included_activities: Launch; spacecraft; satellite networks; earth observation; space communications/infrastructure.
excluded_activities: Defense/aerospace companies with only incidental space exposure.

name: Agribusiness
definition: Companies whose principal business supports agricultural production, inputs, machinery, crop processing or animal/agricultural commodities.
included_activities: Farm machinery; fertilizer/crop inputs; grain processing; agricultural commodities.
excluded_activities: General food brands and retailers.

name: Copper Miners
definition: Mining companies with material copper production or copper-focused mining operations.
included_activities: Copper miners/producers.
excluded_activities: Diversified miners without material copper exposure; copper fabricators.

name: Gold Miners & Royalties
definition: Companies primarily exposed to gold mining, gold royalties or gold streaming.
included_activities: Gold miners; gold royalty/streaming companies.
excluded_activities: Silver-primary miners; diversified miners where gold is not material.

name: Silver Miners
definition: Companies with material primary silver mining exposure.
included_activities: Silver-focused miners and producers.
excluded_activities: Gold-primary miners with incidental silver production.

name: Timber & Forest Products
definition: Companies whose principal business is timberland ownership, forestry, lumber, wood products or pulp/paper tied to forest resources.
included_activities: Timber REITs; lumber/wood products; forest products; pulp/paper.
excluded_activities: Packaging-only companies with little forest-resource exposure.

name: AI Applications & Platforms
definition: Software and platform companies whose commercial value proposition materially centers on artificial intelligence or machine-learning applications.
included_activities: AI analytics/platforms; AI-native applications; AI-driven automation or decisioning.
excluded_activities: General software that merely adds AI features; hardware/infrastructure suppliers.

name: AI Compute & Connectivity Infrastructure
definition: Companies materially supplying compute, cloud capacity, servers, networking, optical interconnect, memory, power or cooling used to train and operate large-scale AI workloads.
included_activities: AI cloud; accelerators; AI servers; networking; optics; memory; data-center power/cooling; rack-scale connectivity.
excluded_activities: Generic SaaS merely using AI; consumer apps; infrastructure with no material AI linkage.

name: Cloud Infrastructure & Platforms
definition: Providers of public-cloud, cloud-native compute, database, edge-delivery or infrastructure platforms used to host and operate software workloads.
included_activities: Hyperscale/public cloud; AI/general cloud platforms; cloud databases; edge/CDN; cloud infrastructure platforms.
excluded_activities: Application SaaS whose main exposure is the application itself; data-center landlords; generic hardware without a cloud platform.

name: Cybersecurity
definition: Companies whose principal products protect identities, endpoints, networks, cloud workloads, data or digital systems from security threats.
included_activities: Endpoint; network; cloud; identity; vulnerability; data security; security operations.
excluded_activities: General IT vendors with security as a small product line.

name: Data Centers & Digital Infrastructure
definition: Owners and operators of data centers, colocation facilities and communications infrastructure whose assets provide physical digital-compute connectivity.
included_activities: Data-center REITs/operators; colocation; communications towers; dedicated data-center developers/operators.
excluded_activities: General cloud software; semiconductor vendors; generic utilities.

name: Digital Assets & Crypto Infrastructure
definition: Companies whose principal economics are directly tied to crypto trading, stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, digital-asset treasury exposure or crypto mining/data-center operations.
included_activities: Crypto exchanges; stablecoin infrastructure; digital-asset managers/platforms; crypto miners; crypto-treasury companies.
excluded_activities: Traditional banks/brokers with incidental crypto offerings.

name: Enterprise & Application Software
definition: Software vendors whose principal business is enterprise, productivity, workflow, design, developer, data-management or business application software.
included_activities: Enterprise applications; productivity; design/engineering software; developer platforms; workflow; databases; observability.
excluded_activities: Cybersecurity pure plays; fintech/payments; AI-specific applications; gaming; cloud infrastructure providers where infrastructure is the main exposure.

name: Internet Platforms & Digital Commerce
definition: Consumer or business internet platforms whose principal economics come from online marketplaces, digital communities, streaming, online travel, advertising or internet commerce.
included_activities: Search/social/community; online marketplaces; streaming; online travel; online commerce platforms.
excluded_activities: Enterprise software; telecom carriers; pure payment processors.

name: Robotics & Physical Automation
definition: Companies whose principal products automate physical processes through robotics, machine vision, industrial control, autonomous machinery or robotic surgery.
included_activities: Industrial robotics/automation; warehouse automation; machine vision; robotic surgery; autonomous industrial/farm systems.
excluded_activities: Pure software automation; semiconductor equipment unless robotics/automation is a material end product.

name: Semiconductors
definition: Companies whose principal business is semiconductor design, manufacturing, memory, analog/power ICs, foundry services, or semiconductor production/test equipment.
included_activities: Chip designers and manufacturers; foundries; memory; semiconductor equipment and test.
excluded_activities: Solar manufacturers; optical-networking vendors without a semiconductor principal business; lidar-only businesses; generic electronics manufacturing.

name: Cannabis
definition: Companies whose principal business is regulated cannabis cultivation, products or distribution.

name: Lithium & Battery Technology
definition: Companies whose principal business is lithium production or battery-cell/material technology.

name: Uranium Miners
definition: Companies whose principal business is uranium mining, exploration or uranium production.

name: Wind Energy
definition: Companies whose principal business materially depends on wind-power generation, wind turbines or wind-specific equipment.

name: Rare Earth & Critical Materials
definition: Companies whose principal business directly produces rare-earth or critical minerals/materials.

name: Steel
definition: Companies whose principal business is steel production.

name: Quantum Computing
definition: Companies whose principal business directly develops quantum-computing hardware, systems or commercial quantum-computing services.

name: Video Games & Interactive Entertainment
definition: Companies whose principal business is video-game development/publishing or game-engine/platform economics.
